metadata.use_case_name: SBOM POC Tool — Ecosystem-Aware Vulnerability Matching

agent_specification.domain: Developer Tooling — Software Supply Chain Security
agent_specification.primary_function: Ecosystem-aware vulnerability matching: dispatch by purl type to the right vulnerability database, replacing the existing single-source NVD/CPE lookup that produces false negatives for non-PyPI ecosystems and propagates fabricated CPEs for GitHub Actions / npm / Go components.
target_users: development teams running automated scans against multi-ecosystem repositories
security teams reviewing SBOM output for accuracy across ecosystems

interaction_patterns.invocation_style: single-run per repository, suitable for integration into automated dev pipelines (CI), unchanged from parent session

key_scenarios: Scan a multi-ecosystem repository (PyPI + npm + GitHub Actions) and produce correct per-ecosystem vulnerability matches
Scan a pure-npm repository and receive OSV.dev-sourced vulnerability hits (where previously NVD returned zero)
Scan a repository containing GitHub Actions and receive GHSA-sourced vulnerability hits (where previously NVD returned zero)
Verify emitted SBOM (CycloneDX/SPDX) contains no fabricated CPE strings for non-NVD-indexed ecosystems
Confirm all existing PyPI vulnerability matching behaviour continues to pass parent-session tests (backward compatibility)

core_skills: PURL-type-based dispatch routing each dependency to the correct vulnerability backend
OSV.dev fixture-driven vulnerability lookup keyed by PURL for npm/golang/cargo/composer/hex/pub/swift ecosystems
GitHub Advisory Database (GHSA) fixture-driven vulnerability lookup keyed by pkg:github/<owner>/<repo>@<version> PURLs
Backward-compatible NVD cache lookup preserved for pypi/nuget/maven/gem/deb/rpm/apk ecosystems
CPE sanitization in CycloneDX/SPDX serializers — strip CPE field from components whose PURL type is not NVD-indexed
Cache pattern parity with parent NVDCacheManager: file-backed sync(source_path) + in-memory dict for OSV and GHSA caches
Deterministic dispatch overhead at O(1) per dep via dict lookup on purl type
knowledge_requirements: PURL (Package URL) specification — type field semantics and ecosystem identifiers
OSV.dev vulnerability schema (id, summary, affected packages, ranges, references)
GitHub Advisory Database schema (GHSA IDs, affected packages by ecosystem)
NVD/CPE indexing scope — which ecosystems NVD covers vs which it does not
CycloneDX and SPDX component representation (purl vs cpe fields)
integration_needs: OSV.dev fixture JSON files (under enhancement fixtures/ or examples/ directory)
GHSA fixture JSON files (under enhancement fixtures/ or examples/ directory)
Parent NVDCacheManager (consumed unchanged via existing API)
Parent CycloneDXSerializer and SPDXSerializer (extended to apply CPE sanitization)
capabilities._reasoning_note: Deterministic dispatch table plus two cache pattern duplications of the existing NVD cache implementation. No AI/ML, no probabilistic matching. Complexity is in correct PURL type routing and ensuring CPE pollution is removed at serialization time.

out_of_scope: Ecosystems beyond the dispatch table listed above
Live network calls to OSV.dev or GitHub at runtime in CI (CLI may optionally support live mode behind a flag, but tests must be fixture-driven)
Modifying parent session files directly — all new artifacts live in enhancement directory; integration via step10_integration.py
Changing CycloneDX/SPDX schemas beyond filtering bogus CPEs

personality._note: Inherited from parent session — CLI tool, machine-facing, non-conversational.

response_time_max._note: Dispatch is a dict lookup on PURL type. Cache lookup remains O(1) per dep. No measurable performance regression vs parent baseline.

concurrent_users._note: Inherited from parent — single-user CLI, single-run.

technical._no_live_network_note: Both OSV and GHSA matchers MUST be fixture-driven. Tests use sample OSV/GHSA JSON files under fixtures/ or examples/. CLI may optionally support live mode behind a flag, but that flag is NOT exercised in CI.
technical._determinism_note: Same inputs always produce same outputs. No timestamps in matcher output. Cache load order is deterministic.
technical.dispatch_overhead: O(1) per dependency (dict lookup on purl type)
technical.cache_lookup_complexity: O(1) per dependency (preserved from parent NVDCacheManager pattern)

backward_compatibility.description: All existing PyPI scan tests in the parent session must continue to pass. The enhanced mapper exposes the same map_vulnerabilities(deps, cache) signature; internally it dispatches by PURL type.

business.scope_boundary: Vulnerability matching layer only — does not touch dependency scanning, deduplication, VEX filtering, remediation enrichment, or NVD sync workflow.
compliance_requirements: SPDX baseline field alignment (inherited from parent)
CycloneDX baseline field alignment (inherited from parent)
Emitted SBOM must not contain fabricated CPE strings for non-NVD-indexed ecosystems
out_of_scope: Live network calls to OSV.dev or GitHub at runtime in CI
Modifying parent session files (the enhancement directory must contain all new artifacts; integration happens via step10_integration.py)
Changing CycloneDX/SPDX schemas beyond filtering bogus CPEs
Adding new ecosystems beyond the dispatch table listed in capabilities.language_scope

ethical._note: Inherited from parent session — no AI/ML components, standard deterministic supply-chain tooling.

domain_model._activation_reason: Enhancement introduces 3 new entities (PurlDispatchTable, OSVCache, GHSACache) and extends 2 existing serializer behaviours

entities.name: PurlDispatchTable
entities.description: Static mapping from PURL type to vulnerability matcher backend. Determines which cache/matcher handles a given dependency.

attributes.name: mapping
attributes._note: Dict[str, str] keyed by purl type, value is matcher identifier: 'nvd' | 'osv' | 'ghsa'

attributes.name: fallback_behaviour
attributes._note: Unknown purl type → no vulnerability match returned; this is preferable to a fabricated CPE lookup

entities.name: EcosystemVulnerabilityMapper
entities.description: New mapper class (or extended VulnerabilityMapper) that dispatches each dependency to the correct backend by PURL type. Replaces single-source NVD lookup with multi-source ecosystem-aware lookup.
entities._signature_contract: map_vulnerabilities(deps, cache) — same as parent VulnerabilityMapper to preserve backward compatibility

entities.name: OSVCache
entities.description: File-backed cache mirroring NVDCacheManager pattern. Ingests OSV.dev fixture JSON via sync(source_path); stores entries in an in-memory dict keyed by PURL.

attributes.name: entries
attributes._note: Dict[str, dict] — key is purl string, value is OSV vulnerability record

attributes.name: source_path
attributes._note: Path to OSV fixture JSON file used during sync()

attributes.name: last_synced_at
attributes._note: Populated by sync(); supports offline/test mode

_methods_required: sync(source_path) — ingest fixture JSON and populate in-memory dict
lookup(purl) — return list of vulnerability records for the given PURL, or empty list
is_synced() — boolean: whether sync has been performed

entities.name: GHSACache
entities.description: File-backed cache mirroring NVDCacheManager pattern. Same structure as OSVCache but keyed specifically by pkg:github/<owner>/<repo>@<version> PURLs and sourced from GitHub Advisory Database fixtures.

attributes.name: entries
attributes._note: Dict[str, dict] — key is github PURL, value is GHSA vulnerability record

_methods_required: lookup(purl) — return list of vulnerability records for the given github PURL, or empty list

entities.name: CPESanitizer
entities.description: Logic applied during SBOM serialization that strips the cpe field from any component whose PURL type is not in the NVD-indexed set. Components keep their PURL — only the bogus CPE is removed.

relationships._note: Parent serializer is extended/wrapped to apply sanitization

engines_and_rules._activation_reason: One deterministic dispatch engine introduced by this enhancement

engines.name: PURL Type Dispatch Engine
engines.purpose: Route each dependency to the correct vulnerability backend based on the type field of its PURL string.

inputs.name: purl
inputs._note: PURL string of the form pkg:<type>/<rest>

outputs.name: matcher_backend
outputs._note: 'none' applies for unknown purl types under fallback_behaviour=return_empty

rule_table.condition: purl.type IN {pypi, nuget, maven, gem, deb, rpm, apk}
purl.type IN {npm, golang, cargo, composer, hex, pub, swift}
purl.type NOT IN any of the above sets
rule_table.action: Return empty vulnerability list (no fabricated lookup)
exceptions: Document the skipped purl type for visibility but do not error the scan

engines.aggregation_hierarchy: PURL → type → matcher backend → vulnerability records

engines.name: CPE Sanitization Engine
engines.purpose: During SBOM serialization, remove the cpe field from any component whose PURL type is not in the NVD-indexed set, to prevent fabricated CPE strings from polluting downstream consumers.

inputs.name: component
inputs._note: Component object as prepared for CycloneDX/SPDX serialization, including purl and (possibly) cpe fields

outputs.name: sanitized_component
outputs._note: Same component with cpe field removed if PURL type is not NVD-indexed

rule_table.rule_id: Sanitize — Keep CPE for NVD-indexed types
rule_table.condition: component.purl.type IN {pypi, nuget, maven, gem, deb, rpm, apk}

rule_table.rule_id: Sanitize — Strip CPE for non-NVD-indexed types
rule_table.condition: component.purl.type NOT IN {pypi, nuget, maven, gem, deb, rpm, apk}
rule_table.action: Remove cpe field from component before emission
exceptions: Component keeps purl field; only cpe is removed

workflow_definitions._activation_reason: Enhancement modifies the matching_vulnerabilities state of the parent Scan Workflow and inserts CPE sanitization into the exporting_sbom state

workflows.name: Enhanced Vulnerability Matching (sub-workflow within parent Scan Workflow's matching_vulnerabilities state)

states.name: received_dep_list
states.description: Deduplicated dependency inventory received from parent Deduplicator

states.name: dispatching_per_dep
states.description: For each dependency, parse PURL and consult PurlDispatchTable

states.name: querying_nvd
states.description: For NVD-routed deps, call NVDCacheManager.lookup (parent behaviour, unchanged)

states.name: merging_results
states.description: Combine vulnerability records from all backends into the unified dep+vuln list expected by downstream parent steps

transitions.trigger: Dep list handed off from Deduplicator

error_paths.recovery_action: Apply fallback (return empty vulnerability list); log skipped type; do not error the scan
Raise actionable error: 'OSV cache not initialized; run sync first'
Raise actionable error: 'GHSA cache not initialized; run sync first'

business_rule_catalog._activation_reason: 5 deterministic business rules introduced by this enhancement

rules.name: Dispatch By PURL Type
rules.condition: EcosystemVulnerabilityMapper receives a dependency for matching
rules.action: Parse PURL, look up type in PurlDispatchTable, route to corresponding backend (nvd | osv | ghsa)

rules.name: Preserve PyPI NVD Path
rules.condition: PURL type is in NVD set (pypi, nuget, maven, gem, deb, rpm, apk)
rules.action: Use parent NVDCacheManager.lookup unchanged — preserve all existing behaviour

rules.rule_id: Strip Fabricated CPEs From SBOM Output
rules.name: Strip Fabricated CPEs From SBOM Output
rules.condition: CycloneDXSerializer or SPDXSerializer is preparing a component for emission AND component.purl.type NOT IN NVD-indexed set
rules.action: Remove the cpe field from the component before emission; preserve purl
rules.else_action: Emit component with cpe field intact (NVD-indexed ecosystems only)

rules.name: No Live Network In CI
rules.condition: Enhancement test suite is running (CI mode)
rules.action: All OSV and GHSA lookups must use fixture files only; zero outbound network calls
rules.else_action: Test must fail if any outbound network call is detected

rules.name: Cache Sync Required Before Lookup
rules.condition: OSVCache or GHSACache.lookup is invoked before sync()
rules.action: Raise actionable error indicating the relevant cache must be synced first

module_inventory._activation_reason: Enhancement introduces 3 new modules and extends 1 existing serialization module

modules.name: EcosystemVulnerabilityMapper
modules.description: New mapper that dispatches by PURL type. Replaces direct calls to parent VulnerabilityMapper in the orchestration path while preserving its public signature.
features: PURL-type dispatch (Rules: Dispatch By PURL Type)
Backward-compatible PyPI/NVD path (Rules: Preserve PyPI NVD Path)
Unified result merging across nvd/osv/ghsa backends

modules.name: OSVCache
modules.description: File-backed cache for OSV.dev vulnerability data. Mirrors parent NVDCacheManager pattern.
features: lookup(purl) — O(1) dict lookup by PURL
external_integrations: OSV.dev fixture JSON files (filesystem only in CI)

modules.name: GHSACache
modules.description: File-backed cache for GitHub Advisory Database vulnerability data. Mirrors parent NVDCacheManager pattern; keyed by pkg:github/* PURLs.
features: lookup(purl) — O(1) dict lookup by PURL
external_integrations: GHSA fixture JSON files (filesystem only in CI)

modules.name: CPESanitizer (serializer extension)
modules.description: CPE sanitization applied during CycloneDX/SPDX serialization. Either implemented as a wrapper around parent serializers or as a behaviour added via subclassing.
features: Strip cpe field from components whose PURL type is not in NVD-indexed set
Preserve purl field for all components

test_categories.description: Tests that PurlDispatchTable correctly maps each ecosystem PURL type to the correct backend identifier
Tests that OSVCache correctly ingests fixture JSON and returns vulnerability records for known PURLs
Tests that GHSACache correctly ingests fixture JSON and returns vulnerability records for known github PURLs
Tests that CycloneDXSerializer and SPDXSerializer strip CPE for non-NVD-indexed ecosystems
Tests that confirm backward compatibility — PyPI deps continue to flow through NVD with identical behaviour to the parent

fixture_requirements: fixtures/osv_sample.json — at least one known-vulnerable PURL per OSV ecosystem (npm, golang, cargo, composer, hex, pub, swift)
fixtures/ghsa_sample.json — at least one known-vulnerable pkg:github/<owner>/<repo>@<version> entry
All fixtures must be deterministic and committed to the enhancement directory

risk_factors: Backward compatibility risk if EcosystemVulnerabilityMapper signature drifts from parent VulnerabilityMapper.map_vulnerabilities(deps, cache)
CPE sanitization risk if implemented in the wrong location (must be in serializers, not in the mapper, to avoid breaking the dependency model used by other parent steps)
Fixture drift risk: OSV/GHSA fixture data must remain in sync with PURL identifiers produced by parent Syft/Trivy adapters
recommendations: Wrap parent CycloneDXSerializer/SPDXSerializer (composition over inheritance) so the parent classes remain untouched and the enhancement's step10_integration can swap the serializer cleanly
Add an integration test that runs the parent session's full PyPI test suite against the enhanced pipeline to catch regressions early
Keep dispatch table values as module-level constants (or a single dict) to make adding new ecosystems a one-line change

type2_quality_indicators._note: Enhancement is fully deterministic dispatch + cache pattern. No AI/ML, no LLM, no probabilistic matching.

sr_11_7_classification.applicability_reason: CLI developer tooling with no financial-domain model-based decisioning (inherited from parent)

classification_schema._note: Dispatch labels for the PURL Type Dispatch Engine — not an AI classification system

integration_notes.integration_strategy: All new artifacts (caches, mapper, serializer extensions, fixtures, tests) live inside the enhancement directory. A step10_integration.py module in the enhancement directory imports parent classes (NVDCacheManager, CycloneDXSerializer, SPDXSerializer) and composes them with the new components without modifying parent files.
integration_notes._parent_file_modifications_note: The enhancement MUST NOT edit any file under outputs/sessions/SBOM-20260409-sb01/ that is not under the enhancements/ subdirectory.
integration_notes.backward_compatibility_test_command: pytest outputs/sessions/SBOM-20260409-sb01/ -k 'pypi or nvd' — must continue to pass against the integrated build
